releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Added tin and bronze
* Added topaz and amber gems
* Changed all gem spawn biomes. Rubies spawn in jungles. Sapphire spawns in dry biomes. Tanzanite spawns in savanna biomes. Topaz spawns in desert biomes. Amber spawns in all biomes.
* Removed all common spawns, as gems are now biome "specific" instead of being found everywhere and being more common in specific biomes
* Tweaked obsidian alloy recipe
* Added bronze tools and armor
* Redid most armor and tool textures
* Removed honey slime


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CamoMano/Enriched/compare/4.2...5.0-beta
